The Longevity Science Academy bridges the gap between outdated education and cutting‑edge biohacking.
The program transforms personal experimentation into structured, scientifically grounded coaching practice.
Graduates gain credibility, depth, and tools to lead clients through real, lasting health optimization.

blocks.text: They won’t settle for “normal.” They don’t buy the idea that feeling worn out at 40 is simply aging, that brain fog is only stress, or that low energy is something to manage, not fix. They studied the reports. They monitor how they sleep. They try changing what they eat, how much light they get, and how they breathe. Without much fuss and often unnoticed, they end up being their own best doctors.
Maybe that person is you.
And if it is, then at some point — whether it happened slowly or in a single moment of clarity — you probably asked yourself a question that changed everything:
What if I could help other people feel this way too?
The Gap Nobody Talks About

The wellness industry is enormous. It’s worth over $5.6 trillion globally and growing faster than almost any other sector on earth. There are more health coaches, nutritionists, and [wellness consultants](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/top-wellness-retreats-in-the-us) than ever before.
And yet most of them are underequipped.

Not because they’re not passionate — they are. Not because they don’t care about their clients — most of them care deeply. But because the education they received was built for a different era. An era before we understood the hallmarks of cellular aging. Before continuous glucose monitors sat on people’s arms. Before the average health-conscious person knew what mTOR was, what NMN does, or why their HRV number matters more than the number on the scale.
The world has moved fast. Coaching education has not kept up.
This gap between information and practical application is exactly why the [**Longevity Science Academy**](https://academy.biohackers.world/) was created.
What This Program Actually Is
It would be easy to describe this as a certification course. And technically, it is. You’ll graduate with a credential, a coaching methodology, and the professional tools to build a serious practice.
But that description undersells what’s really happening here.

What this program does is transform the way you think about human health. It takes everything you’ve learned through years of self-experimentation and obsessive research and gives it structure, depth, and scientific grounding. It connects the dots between disciplines — sleep science, metabolic health, cognitive neuroscience, exercise physiology, supplement biochemistry — that most practitioners keep siloed. And it gives you a framework for translating all of that knowledge into real change for real clients.

The program lives on Thinkific, which means you move through it at your own pace, on your own schedule. But don’t mistake self-paced for lightweight. This is rigorous material. The kind of material that makes you pause a lecture, open three browser tabs, and spend an hour falling down a research rabbit hole because you’re genuinely excited about what you just learned.

It also includes **Thrive Unlimited** — a full biohacking-inspired personal development program that normally sells separately. It’s built into the Coach Training because Mark believes, rightly, that the best coaches do their own inner work first. You can’t lead someone else toward a life they’ve never seen if you haven’t built that life yourself.

On Mark, and Why He Built This
Every great program has an origin story. This one starts with Mark.

Mark is not a wellness influencer with a supplement line. He’s not a former athlete turned motivational speaker. He is someone who went deep — really deep — into the science of longevity and human optimization, and then spent years figuring out how to make that science usable for actual people living actual lives.

[Mark’s experience](https://www.biohackers.world/speakers/dr-mark-atkinson) in the longevity and biohacking space, combined with the collective expertise of the Biohackers World network, helped shape the vision behind the Academy. The result is an educational experience grounded not only in theory, but also in years of conversations, events, expert insights, and real-world application across the global biohacking community.

What Mark teaches isn’t a collection of hacks. It’s a way of thinking — a systems-level understanding of the human body that lets you adapt to any client, any situation, any new piece of research that comes out next month or next year. Because in a field moving as fast as longevity science, the coaches who will still be relevant in ten years are the ones who know how to think, not just what to do.

The Academy was designed around the idea that meaningful learning happens through interaction, not just information. Alongside the self-paced curriculum, students participate in live online classes every two weeks, creating opportunities to ask questions, discuss real-world challenges, and learn directly from experienced practitioners. Instead of consuming content alone, students become part of an ongoing learning experience that evolves through [conversation, feedback, and community](https://www.biohackers.world/events).
Two Kinds of People Walk In

Ask the people who’ve been drawn to this program what they have in common, and the surface-level answers vary wildly. One person is a 38-year-old personal trainer who started reading longevity research during lockdown and hasn’t stopped. Another is a naturopath with a decade of clinical experience who keeps getting questions she doesn’t feel fully equipped to answer. Another is a former corporate executive who optimized herself out of burnout and now wants to help others do the same.
Different backgrounds. Different goals. Different chapters of life.

But underneath all of it, the same thing: a conviction that the current model of health — reactive, fragmented, focused on disease management rather than optimization — is not good enough. And a desire to be part of building something better.

The program is explicitly designed for two groups. The first are [**biohackers and health enthusiasts**](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking) who have the passion and the personal experience but want the professional credibility, the scientific depth, and the structured methodology to work with clients and build a real practice. The second are **existing coaches and health practitioners** — people already working with clients — who know that the longevity and biohacking space is where their clients are heading, and who want to be ahead of the curve rather than catching up to it.
Both belong here. Both will be challenged. Both will leave transformed.

The Honest Conversation About Investment
Let’s talk about the investment, because it’s a real one and it deserves a real conversation.
The full program is priced at **$4,499** . Regular discounts bring that to around $3,599 or lower. There are special discount cases for the right circumstances.

For some people, that number will feel immediately right. They’ll see it as what it is: a professional education in one of the most valuable and fastest-growing fields in health, delivered by someone with genuine expertise, at a depth that simply doesn’t exist at this price point anywhere else.
For others, the number will give them pause. And that pause is worth sitting with, because there’s a useful question hiding inside it:
What is it costing me to not know what I’d learn here?

Not in some abstract sense. Concretely. If you’re a coach who’s charging $80 a session because you don’t have the scientific credibility to charge $250 — what does that gap cost you over a year? If you’re a practitioner who’s sending clients elsewhere for the biohacking and [longevity](https://www.biohackers.world/shop/nad-advanced-longevity-protocol) questions they’re starting to ask — what does that cost you in client retention, in referrals, in professional identity?

Certified longevity coaches with this depth of training routinely charge $150 to $500 per session. Multi-month programs are priced from $2,000 to $15,000 and up. The math is not complicated. This investment pays for itself with a handful of clients.

**Early access enrollment opens June 1st.** The public announcement follows on June 12th. The target is 450 students in the first twelve months — which means spots, especially at preferred pricing, are not unlimited.
What Comes After

There’s a moment that happens to almost everyone who goes through a program like this. It comes somewhere in the middle — not at the beginning when everything is new, and not at the end when the certificate arrives, but somewhere in the thick of it, when a concept finally clicks or a framework suddenly makes sense across three different domains at once.
The moment where you realize you’re not the same person who enrolled.

That moment is what the [Biohackers World](https://www.biohackers.world/events/chicago) Longevity & Biohacking Coach Training is designed to produce. Not just credentials. Not just content. A genuine shift in how you understand the human body, what’s possible within it, and what your role is in helping others discover that for themselves.

The longevity revolution doesn’t need more people talking about biohacking on the internet. It needs people who can actually deliver it — who can sit across from a client, understand their biology, design a protocol that fits their life, and coach them through the hard parts of change.
That’s who you could be.
The question is whether you’re ready to become it.
